text:
maria: Heads up — want to run a dry-run for the new latency-aware quota routing change (route-shard quota increase + safemode predicate). Goal is to validate p95 impact before we flip on for 100% traffic.

kevin: SG. Can you paste the config you want to dry-run?

maria: pasted below — it's intended to increase default quota for shard=eu-west to 1200r/s but only in dry-run mode and gated by p95 latency telemetry.

maria: ```yaml
routes:
  - id: eu-west-shard
    quota: 1200
    dry_run: true
    telemetry_gate:
      metric: p95_latency_ms
      threshold: 200
      eval_window: 5m
      sampling_rate: 0.03
    safemode_predicate: "route_capacity > 0 and healthy_backends > 1"
```

priya: Nice. A couple of UX asks if we're going to expose this in console preview: 1) show estimated token/sec cost delta, 2) show sampled impact chart (sampled traffic only), 3) show a quick link to replay sampled requests in staging.

ollie: Concern: sampled traffic won't surface cold-cache misses or rare KV-cache regressions. We should also run a 1h targeted canary at 1% real traffic with no dry-run to verify caches.

kevin: Agree about cache. Proposal: two-phase validation: (A) dry-run with telemetry gating and 3% sampling for 2h (no user-visible routing), then (B) 1% live canary for 1h with circuit-breaker threshold and automatic rollback.

maria: Sounds good. For the console preview I want a single-click "Start dry-run" that wires up the telemetry gate automatically. If gate trips, we show why and the last 20 sampled requests that contributed.

priya: UX mock: show timeline with gate metric overlay + a compact table of sampled requests (method, path, p95 delta, model-version). Also add a "Save as rollout template" button.

kevin: Implementation note: the runtime needs an API that returns gate-eval logs keyed by config id. Something like: GET /internal/configs/{id}/dryrun-events?since=...

maria: Yep. Event payload shape we'd like: {config_id, eval_ts, metric, value, threshold, decision, sample_request_id}. Keep it minimal.

kevin: Quick draft of the dry-run trigger call:

kevin: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/internal/configs/eu-west-shard/dryrun \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"duration":"2h","sampling_rate":0.03}'
```

ollie: Add a TTL on dry-run so it auto-expires. Also require an owner tag in the payload so ops knows who to page.

maria: Agree — add owner + reason. Ops on-call shouldn't get paged for expected dry-runs. We need a flag to suppress alerts during dry-run unless gate trips badly.

ops-bot: dry-run-policy-check: config eu-west-shard passed basic policy (owner present, duration <= 4h, sampling_rate <= 5%). :white_check_mark:

priya: For the console flow: show a subtle banner: "This is a dry-run — traffic not routed. Telemetry gating evaluates whether the change would have been applied." :information_source:

kevin: Telemetry gating details: eval_window 5m with sliding p95. If p95 exceeds threshold for 2 consecutive windows, decision=FAIL. We should surface both raw numbers and moving average.

maria: On rollback semantics: if gate FAILs during step B (live canary), we should auto-fallback to previous routing and stamp an incident marker in the rollout timeline. For dry-run failure just surface findings.

ollie: One more: we need to include a small synthetic traffic check for cache warmup during the 1% canary. If synthetic traffic warms caches and p95 improves, then we mark "cache effect observed" in results.

kevin: I'll wire up the backend API and a small telemetry consumer that emits gate-eval events to the events-store. Planning to land the API PR today.

maria: Thanks. Can you add a minimal schema to the PR so UI can start wiring? Something like:

maria: ```json
{
  "config_id": "string",
  "eval_ts": "iso8601",
  "metric": "p95_latency_ms",
  "value": "int",
  "threshold": "int",
  "decision": "PASS|FAIL|NO_DATA",
  "sample_request_id": "string|null"
}
```

kevin: Will do. I'll @deploy-bot to run the internal policy checks after PR lands.

deploy-bot: queued job run for PR #4821 — policy checks started.

priya: Timeline: if API PR lands today and UI can stub the events endpoint, we can demo console preview in tomorrow's cadence review. :calendar:

maria: Perfect. After the dry-run completes we'll collect: gate-eval timeline, sampled-request table, cost delta estimate, and a decision recommendation.

ollie: Tagging follow-ups: (1) add synthetic warmup step, (2) ensure sampling doesn't bias by user-tier, (3) retention policy for sampled requests (30d).

kevin: Noted. I'll create a short checklist and drop in the PR description.

maria: Thanks all. Starting the dry-run in ~30m. Will paste results here once we have a few windows. :eyes:
